# Two Design Tools I Built for Shaping Aircraft Wings
While working through a design-tool concept, I built two tools I wanted for my own work: **WINGFORM_NEXT**, for designing aircraft wings, and **CurveEditor_rev5**, for recording and editing straight-line and spline geometry. I plan to make both available at no cost.
## WINGFORM\_NEXT: shape a wing and inspect it in 3D
WINGFORM_NEXT is a Windows application for aircraft-wing design. You can edit a wing outline in plan view, set airfoils and section positions, adjust height and bending, and inspect the result in a 3D preview.
The plan view lets you edit points and edges directly, choosing a straight segment or spline for each edge. You can refine the outline while setting rib angles and section positions. The model can be exported in formats including STEP, STL, and Blender.
Separate Japanese and English packages are available as **v0.3.6 for Windows x64**. Extract the complete ZIP and launch WINGFORM_NEXT.exe; Python does not need to be installed.

 J’cuuzi played Chess Club during Free Week 2025.

 Another low-cost weekend of up-and-coming local music is in the works for Austin in the new year. Free Week, a donation-based festival across the Red River Cultural District, is scheduled for January 9 and 10, 2026.

  Austinites may have gotten a recent taste of the festival while attending its seasonally diverse sibling, Hot Summer Nights , from July 24-26. Free Week is the same with less sweating, and during a part of the year when theres really not much going on downtown; that was part of the initial idea, when Free Week was developed to drive revenue for venues during a slow season.

 At the same time that venues are getting help, artists are being paid through donations and sponsors, making Free Week a mutually beneficial structure for those who decide to participate. The audience gets the best deal of all, sampling from a huge lineup all within about a mile.

  A press release says attendees should expect 100+ artists, many of whom are also regulars. Austin-based bands, artists, and DJs can apply to play at free week via Google Forms . The beauty of Free Week is its readiness to platform very small local artists, so this is a great place for newer performers to try connecting with a wider audience.

 Some bands who played Free Week (and Hot summer Nights) in recent years have new material out, so wed love to think Jcuuzi , Daiistar , and Dossey might show up on the lineup next to many other personal faves.

# SXP Choir 1.2: Free Formant Synth Adds Tempo-Synced LFO and Vowel Copy

SXP Choir 1.2 is a free formant synthesizer with tempo-synced LFO, vowel copy/paste, VST3/AU versions and an exact developer video demonstration.

 By Sebastian McQueen Published November 9, 2026 

SXP Choir 1.2.0 is the current free formant synthesizer from SXP Plugins, updated again after the November 1 release of version 1.1. Rather than playing real choir recordings, it shapes synthesizer tones with a five-band formant filter to suggest human vowels. Its eight-note polyphony, continuous vowel morphing and MIDI control suit ambient, cinematic and electronic music. The developer currently supplies Windows and macOS versions, with free activation available until the end of 2026. Here is how the instrument works, what changed and how to get it from the official source.

## Formant synthesis, not a recorded choir

A sampled choir library plays performances captured from singers. Choir uses resonant frequency bands to suggest the distinctive character of human vowels. Move those bands while holding a MIDI note, and the sound can seem to shift between vowel shapes without changing pitch. That makes it especially useful for evolving pads, synthetic voices and science-fiction textures. It cannot provide authentic words, consonants or elaborate choir articulations. Treat its name as a description of the sound-design direction, not a claim that the plugin contains actual recorded singing.

According to SXP’s current release notes, version 1.2.0 adds tempo synchronization for the LFO: right-click its Speed control and choose sync to follow the song tempo. WINGFORM_NEXT: shape a wing and inspect it in 3D
WINGFORM_NEXT is a Windows application for aircraft-wing design. You can edit a wing outline in plan view, set airfoils and section positions, adjust height and bending, and inspect the result in a 3D preview.
The plan view lets you edit points and edges directly, choosing a straight segment or spline for each edge. You can refine the outline while setting rib angles and section positions. The model can be exported in formats including STEP, STL, and Blender.
